about: Mona Shores' two robots, 19429 (Infrared) and 20245 (Ultraviolet), for the match and drill simulator. Data only: src/sim/robots/mona-shores.ts maps it onto upstream's RobotConfig. Every number has a source: a biobuzz file (master), a measured log or film, or 'upstream' where neither team has data. null means not measured yet, so upstream's value stays.

slewDegPerSec.source: not measured; floor is 10-13 deg/s (RobotDifferences 19429, 20 Nov), top rate unlogged

release.source: the feeder sends the lane through the throat in order

betweenBallsS.source: biobuzz timing-terms.md, Belding: about 0.45 s between balls

spinUpWaitS.source: biobuzz timing-terms.md, Belding, launcher already running

topSpeedInPerS.source: biobuzz AutoSim: 77 in/s peak, real-robot logs

accelInPerS2.source: biobuzz AutoSim: 63-71 in/s^2 from rest; braking 48-76

flowerStick.source: biobuzz RobotDifferences: roller on its end, a CR servo (17 Nov 2026)
biobuzz FlowerStickSubsystem: no roller; held out
